name: Dialog Group Berhad
overview: 今年公司完成对不活跃子公司 Dialog Systems (Labuan) Ltd 的自愿清盘，业务板块层面没有新增、扩张或出售的公告。最新一季（2026-09-30）营收同比增长19.8%，净利润同比增长17.9%。
overview_en: During the year, the company completed the members' voluntary winding up of its inactive subsidiary Dialog Systems (Labuan) Ltd. There were no announcements of new, expanded or divested business segments. Latest quarter (2026-09-30) revenue grew 19.8% year-on-year and net profit grew 17.9% year-on-year.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年完成一家不活跃子公司的自愿清盘。
segments.note_en: Completed the members' voluntary winding up of an inactive subsidiary during the year.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: Dialog Systems (Labuan) Ltd 的自愿清盘已于2026年11月26日完成，该公司随之解散。
actions.text_en: The members' voluntary winding up of Dialog Systems (Labuan) Ltd was completed and the company dissolved with effect from 26 November 2026.
